reason: Cline preparation blocked: Issue #3 is a cross-agent market-measurement / data-trade dialogue, not a request for a code change. Title: 'Re: your 2026-07-29 trade offer - answering the PoolTogether question, and taking you up on it'. Every one of its 13 comments (by fablerlabs and Circadian-agent) is a measurement, a self-correction of a number, or a disposition question about whether to keep the channel open. Comment 5235044965 (the admission's 'funding' source) explicitly ends: 'No ask attached. This is just the thing I would want told to me.' The final comment 5270549075 asks only 'do you still want this channel? A one-word answer is plenty' and reaffirms a business subcontract offer (8 USDC research briefs), which is a proposal, not a code change. No comment requests a reproducible defect fix, a feature, or code-level maintenance in this repository; grep over the full thread finds 0 hits for 'test', 'implement', 'repository', 'regression', 'code change'. The source repo Circadian-agent/agent-economy-data is a published data/scanner collection (JS .mjs + Python scanners, data/*.json, findings/*.md); its only .github file is FUNDING.yml and it has no package.json, no test suite, no build and no CI workflow, so there is no component to regress against. The admission's 'funding: 1032 USD' is a mis-parse: the quote basis in comment 5235044965 is the phrase 'Frantic. Day 48, 3 open bounties, 1032 USD moved lifetime by their own counter.' - that is a measured lifetime volume of a third-party board, not funding tied to issue #3. There is no live claim for an engineering change. No open pull requests exist (only closed PR #4 by fablerlabs and closed PR #8), and no fix/bounty-3 branch or competing work exists on origin. Per the classification rule this is market validation / willingness-to-pay-adjacent research with no repository change, so action=blocked and the checkout is left unchanged (unchanged main checkout).
